labels.title: SLEAP labels package (.pkg.slp)
labels.description: Your labeled frames as a SLEAP labels package (.pkg.slp). In SLEAP, File → Export Labels Package (include the images), so the file holds the frames it was labeled on.

val_labels.title: Validation labels (optional)
val_labels.description: Optional separate validation labels (.pkg.slp). Leave empty to hold out 10% of the labeled frames.

model_type.title: Model type
model_type.description: single_instance: one animal per frame. topdown: several animals, trains a centroid and a centered-instance model (best when animals are well separated). bottomup: several animals in one model (better when animals touch or overlap).

model_size.title: Receptive field
model_size.description: Receptive field of sleap-nn's preset. Large sees more context; use it for large animals relative to the frame.

max_epochs.title: Maximum epochs
max_epochs.description: Upper limit; training stops early when validation loss stops improving.

title.title: Viewer title
title.description: Title shown at the top of the viewer

gpu.title: Use a GPU
gpu.description: Train on a GPU (needs the project's GPU limit above 0). Off trains on CPU, which takes hours for real datasets.

input_scale.title: Input scale (0 = preset)
input_scale.description: Resize frames by this factor before training (e.g. 0.5 for large frames); 0 keeps the preset's scale.

sleap_nn_version.title: sleap-nn version
sleap_nn_version.description: sleap-nn release installed at run time
